title: The Old Cow at the Gate
logline: At dusk a herder drives the cattle into the pen; at dawn he opens the gate, and it's never the strongest animal that leaves first, it's whoever ended up nearest the door.
human_question: Does what matters most always come first, or just what's closest to hand?

premise.story: A day and night in a dry-zone cattle herder's routine, driving animals into the pen at dusk and letting them out at dawn.
premise.place: A small dry-zone village with common cattle pens.
premise.experience: Dust, lowing animals, a herder's practised patience, and the simple fact of watching which animal actually leaves the gate first.

concept_links.why: This is the source's own image for why what is nearest a life's end can outweigh what is strongest in it: an old, weak cow nearest the gate leaves the pen before all the others [C056-P:L119]. The film needs no explanation if the herder's real routine is simply followed.

what_camera_could_observe: The herder settling disputes among animals for space
The actual order in which animals leave
what_must_be_real: A working herder's real routine, not one staged to match the simile. If the animals do not behave as the old story suggests, the film follows what actually happens.

possible_arc.opening: Dust and noise as the herd is driven into the pen at dusk.
possible_arc.turn: A quiet night; the herder's own account of the animals he knows individually.
possible_arc.ending_open: The gate opens. The order the animals leave in is whatever it is.

requirements: A working cattle pen with a herder willing to be filmed over a dusk-to-dawn cycle

suggestions.name: A village near Polonnaruwa or Anuradhapura
suggestions.why: Traditional cattle-herding communities are still active in this dry-zone area.
suggestions.verify: No specific herder or pen identified.

risks: Staging the shot to force the simile onto real animal behaviour
drop_if: The animals' actual order contradicts the simile and the film cannot honestly use the image
No working herder will allow overnight filming

connections.note: Both use an ordinary, everyday image, cattle at a gate, debts in a ledger, to carry the same idea about what comes due and when.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
